blocks.body:
## Baseline verdict

Nimbo is **not ready to scale acquisition**. The public-rank goal is unmet, the iOS 1.0.1 crash still lacks a symbolicated diagnostic report, and Open-Meteo promotion clearance is not attached. The Play conversion read is above target as reported, but its denominator must be reconciled before it can support a decision.

## Operating rule

Unknown quality, provider, or physical-device evidence is never converted into a pass. Store publishing, external outreach, and any spend remain explicit action-time approval steps.

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · obtain report, symbolicate, fix, re-smoke
gate_snapshot.evidence: 1 crash on iOS 1.0.1 on 2026-08-25; no stack trace available
gate_snapshot.next_action: Obtain the Organizer/diagnostic report, symbolicate, reproduce, fix, and re-smoke

gate_snapshot.decision: PENDING · obtain written clearance or license
gate_snapshot.evidence: Free endpoint is documented for non-commercial use; no written promotion clearance attached
gate_snapshot.next_action: Obtain written clearance or approve a separately costed licensed endpoint

gate_snapshot.decision: PARTIAL · API 24/36 emulator and physical API 25 paths pass
gate_snapshot.evidence: Final debug APK passed localized quick-city selection, live forecast, and cold start on API 24/36 emulators and physical API 25, plus physical search. The immediately preceding runtime-identical candidate passed API 24 offline recovery; signed tablet, share, background, and accessibility coverage remains incomplete
gate_snapshot.next_action: Run the versioned signed RC on the remaining tablet, share, background, and accessibility matrix

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · iPad bounded pass; mount iPhone DDI
gate_snapshot.evidence: Release passed iOS 18.1 simulator and bounded physical iPad live-provider/cold-launch paths; the required iPhone is connected without a mountable Developer Disk Image
gate_snapshot.next_action: Unlock/reconnect the iPhone, mount DDI, then run denied-location, search, offline, share, VoiceOver, widget, and cold-start paths

accessIssues.message: Raw App Store Connect and Play Console exports with country, source, device, version, and denominator definitions are not attached.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('App Store','Impressions','206','reported_console_readout'),('App Store','First-time downloads','5','reported_console_readout'),('App Store','Conversion rate','4.05%','reported_console_readout'),('App Store','Ratings','0','reported_console_readout'),('App Store','Crashes','1','live_console_2026-08-28'),('Google Play','Impressions','779','reported_console_readout'),('Google Play','Installations','21','live_console_2026-08-28'),('Google Play','First launches','14','live_console_2026-08-28'),('Google Play','Monthly active users','11','live_console_2026-08-28'),('Google Play','Conversion rate','40.82%','reported_console_readout'),('Google Play','Ratings','1','reported_console_readout')) AS baseline(platform,metric,value,evidence_class)
query.description: Loads the bounded, versioned baseline while preserving reported console definitions.
tables_used: inline baseline values backed by growth/baseline/2026-08-28.json
metric_definitions: Apple conversion is the App Store Connect reported value
Play conversion is the reported Play value and remains unreconciled
First launch rate is 14 / 21 and is directional only

query.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('App Store UZ search','all','weather','81',10,'fixed_public_capture'),('App Store UZ Weather chart','official','category','>100',10,'fixed_public_capture'),('Google Play UZ Weather category','uz-UZ','category','>30',10,'fixed_logged_out_capture'),('Google Play UZ Weather category','ru-UZ','category','>30',10,'fixed_logged_out_capture'),('Google Play UZ Weather category','en-UZ','category','>30',10,'fixed_logged_out_capture'),('Google Play UZ generic-query quorum','2-of-3 profiles','five configured queries','0 qualifying queries',2,'fixed_logged_out_capture')) AS ranks(surface,profile,query,observed_rank,target_rank,evidence_class)
query.description: Loads the complete fixed public-rank capture while preserving bounded absences.
tables_used: inline rank values backed by growth/data/public-rank/2026-08-28.json
filters: Google logged-out profiles uz-UZ, ru-UZ, en-UZ
metric_definitions: A >N result is a bounded absence, not a synthetic rank
Google generic success requires Top-10 on at least two of three profiles for at least two queries
